title.narrative: Supporting stability in South Lebanon through Livelihoods, Basic Services and Community Security Interventions

description.narrative: Increase stability, build the capacities of communities, address tensions, prevent conflict, and ensure peaceful co-existence through improving livelihoods and service provision in the area of UNI-FIL’s Ghanaian Battalion.

The objective of the project is to increase stability, build the capacities of communities, address tensions, prevent conflict, and ensure peaceful co-existence through improving livelihoods and service provision in Southern Lebanon. The project will target the area of operations of UNIFIL’s Ghanaian Battalion (GHANBATT), which falls under the Bint Jbeil (Nabatiyeh Governorate) and Tyre (South Governorate) administrative districts, with a total of 11 municipalities selected in dialogue with UNIFIL. These communities were selected as they are the largest in the GHANBATT area of operations and are in high need of livelihoods, basic services, and community security interventions. The partnership between UNIFIL and UNDP will combine efforts in order to meet the growing needs in the area in light of the economic and livelihood crisis in Lebanon and now ongoing armed conflict with Israel. This will be achieved by working on complementary analysis and assessment, where UNDP will complement UNIFIL’s Quick Impact Projects with more medium-term, sustainable interventions informed by community needs and instability drivers.
